notes: Pubs, bars and bottle shops: OpenStreetMap. The newest open South Australian licence list is from August 2019 and has no map locations, so it isn't used yet.
Adelaide has only 86 suburbs dense enough to map, so the tests have less to go on here and results are weaker evidence.

Grey areas: suburbs with fewer than 1,000 residents or fewer than 300 people per km² (parks, farmland, bush, airports, industrial land). The Census covers them, but they are left out so empty land doesn't count as much as busy suburbs. The grey areas on this map hold 11,823 people, 1.0% of the total.

explain.the-hi-vis-line:
What does "hi-vis" mean?

Hi-vis is Australian slang for the bright, high-visibility vests worn on building sites, roads, warehouses and delivery routes.

Here it means driving, machine and labouring jobs, compared with managers and professionals. It describes jobs, not people.
